text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
D-Did I win...?
I really won, didn't I...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's McQueen for ya!!
She was insanely strong this time too!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I lost again, huh...?
I knew it, I'm always—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: That was pure grit!! Ryan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Hanging on so tenaciously right until the end...!!
You were so incredibly cool, Ryan...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family is the absolute best—!!
You both did an amazing job—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both for the greatest race ever...!!
I will never, ever forget today!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Me too...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is right, Ryan!
You remained strong until the very end...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone was captivated by that strength!
By your strength to always keep looking forward...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My... strength...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: S-Somehow... it feels like everyone knows me better than I know myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I see...
Strong, huh...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! Thank you all
so much for your support!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen came to a close
with a glorious victory by Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we managed to safely
wrap up the Takarazuka Kinen, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
By racing against Ryan,
my next objective has become clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Our next target is the Autumn Tenno Sho—
in other words, winning both the Spring and Autumn editions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is a feat that no one in the Mejiro family
has ever accomplished before, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now that Grandmother has entrusted this to me,
I want to show everyone a new path forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To Grandmother... and to everyone in the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning both the Spring and Autumn Tenno Sho in the same year. Facing this new goal,
a fiery resolve blazed in Mejiro McQueen's eyes.
